## TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. This is an Ather Value Voucher issued by GyFTR for the purchase of Ather electric two-wheelers, and it can be redeemed only on the dedicated Ather redemption page at gyftr.com/redeem/ather.
2. The person logged in to the Ather redemption page at the time of voucher addition is deemed to be the beneficiary.
3. To redeem the voucher, the beneficiary must log in to the Ather redemption page using their mobile number and OTP, add the voucher balance to their wallet, and complete the booking form with the required personal and vehicle preference details.
4. Only one Voucher can be used per booking. A new Voucher can be purchased only after the booking form for the existing Voucher has been submitted.
5. Once the voucher balance is added to the wallet, the voucher is marked as redeemed on the platform.
6. After the booking form is submitted, the GyFTR team or its authorised fulfilment partner will contact the beneficiary to verify the submitted information before passing it on to Ather for final voucher issuance.
7. The voucher is valid for 30 days from the date of issue. Under no circumstances will the validity be extended, except in cases of delivery delay beyond the validity period, where the voucher tenure will be suitably extended.
8. The voucher does not carry any monetary value and can only be used towards the purchase of an Ather vehicle on the terms stated herein.
9. The voucher is not applicable on Ather Rizta and Ather 350 models.
10. The beneficiary may choose any Ather model with Ather Stackpro. The GyFTR Contribution (voucher value) shall be utilised only on the ex-showroom price (including GST) of the vehicle. Any difference between the on-road price (including road tax, insurance, and state taxes) and the voucher value shall be paid directly by the beneficiary to the Ather dealership.
11. Ather pro-pack, Ather Battery Protect, Ather Connect, and any other subscriptions or accessories (whether or not bundled with the vehicle) shall be purchased separately by the beneficiary.
12. The vehicle, model, and colour, once selected and the Balance Price paid, cannot be changed later.
13. The vehicle will be invoiced on the final price, inclusive of applicable taxes, as on the time of intimation or delivery, whichever is later. Appointed dealerships cannot be changed or altered.
14. Central and State subsidies shall be applicable as per availability from the Government at the time of billing.
15. The beneficiary must carry the proper ID proofs submitted at the time of issue of the voucher, along with the original letter of intimation, at the time of vehicle delivery.
16. The voucher cannot be clubbed with any ongoing offers, discounts, or promotions at Ather dealerships or experience centres.
17. The voucher is non-refundable, non-transferable, may not be exchanged or resold, and may not be redeemed for cash.
18. GyFTR is not responsible if the voucher is lost, stolen, or used without permission.
19. Any dispute related to the voucher should be referred to the issuing company, and the decision of the issuing company shall be final.
20. Ather Energy Limited/GyFTR reserves the right to withdraw, modify, cancel, or change the offer at any point without prior notice and at its sole discretion.
21. For any queries or issues related to the voucher, kindly raise a request at www.gvhelpdesk.com.
